रुरु m. (-रुः)
 1. A sort of deer.
 2. A Daitya flayed by ŚIVA.
 E. रु to weep, कु aff.

रुरुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
 1. Wishing to oppose or obstruct.
 2. Wishing
to bind or tie up, (as the hair.)
 E. रुध् to oppose, desid. v., उ aff.

रुरुदिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or purposing to wail or weep, ready
to cry.
 E. रुद् to weep, desid. v., उ aff.
